Definition: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
BiblicalUsage: Zion is the mountain of Jerusalem, the hill God chose for His name and His temple. In 2 Samuel 5:7, Nevertheless David took the strong hold of Zion. The place has its own entry in Biblical Places.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Zion reminds me Scripture happened somewhere, not in the abstract.
RelatedEvents: David Brings the Ark to Jerusalem
